description: Join one term to another of the same project when they are one notion — «Размерные подгруппы» into «Размерная подгруппа». The joined term's name and spellings become the target's variants (so the reading does not offer that spelling again), its links move to the target, and the joined term is gone; this cannot be undone. The target keeps its definition, kind, source and place — with 'takeDefinition', the joined term's definition replaces it, together with the source and place it was read from. The result is confirmed if either was; two proposed terms stay proposed. 'similar' in list_terms names terms that look alike up to the form of their words. Members of the project who may write only. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

from.description: The term to join to the other, as list_terms returned it — it is removed.

takeDefinition.description: true to take the joined term's definition, with its source and place, instead of the target's. Default false.

name: merge_terms
